description: Optional declarative local-first deep research and evidence pack for plans, source quality, citation maps, evidence cards, and synthesis reports.

optional_dependencies.reason: Can turn research outputs into workspace documents, decks, PDFs, charts, sheets, and export bundles.
Can orchestrate long-running research jobs while this pack provides research recipes and evidence contracts.
Can provide concrete local file and preview implementations for research artifacts.

defaultspack.overlap: Uses default runtime/profile conventions without replacing defaultspack.

rumi_workspace_pack.overlap: Both mention reports and artifacts; research owns evidence and citation contracts, workspace owns editable artifact/export contracts.
rumi_workspace_pack.conflict: none; compose through explicit rumi_research_pack and rumi_workspace_pack namespaces

rumi_agent_services_pack.overlap: Both mention long-running work; research owns workflow recipes, agent services owns execution orchestration.
rumi_agent_services_pack.conflict: none; service execution should reference research recipes by catalog id

base_pack_promotion.reason: Research pack augments defaultspack with evidence declarations and must not become the default runtime pack.

compatibility.notes: This pack is declarative and local-first. Concrete network retrieval, connector sync, or background execution must be supplied by another pack with its own grants.
